Prob138_2012_q2fsm.code:
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  w,
    output z
);

    // State encoding (one-hot or binary)
    // Let's use 3-bit binary encoding:
    // A = 3'b000, B = 3'b001, C = 3'b010, D = 3'b011, E = 3'b100, F = 3'b101
    
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;

    // State flip-flops (positive edge triggered, synchronous active-high reset)
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            state <= 3'b000; // Reset to A
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // State table / next-state logic (separate always block)
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: begin // State A
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b001; // B
                else
                    next_state = 3'b000; // A
            end
            3'b001: begin // State B
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b010; // C
                else
                    next_state = 3'b011; // D
            end
            3'b010: begin // State C
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b100; // E
                else
                    next_state = 3'b011; // D
            end
            3'b011: begin // State D
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b101; // F
                else
                    next_state = 3'b000; // A
            end
            3'b100: begin // State E
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b100; // E (self-loop)
                else
                    next_state = 3'b011; // D
            end
            3'b101: begin // State F
                if (w == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 3'b010; // C
                else
                    next_state = 3'b011; // D
            end
            default: next_state = 3'b000;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic using continuous assignment
    assign z = (state == 3'b100) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // z is high only in state E

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  [3:0] in,
    output [1:0] pos
);

    // Priority encoder logic:
    // The first '1' from the MSB side (bit 3) determines the output.
    // If in == 4'b0000, pos outputs 2'b00.

    always @(*) begin
        case (in)
            4'b1xxx: pos <= 2'b00;  // bit 3 is high
            4'b01xx: pos <= 2'b01;  // bit 2 is high
            4'b001x: pos <= 2'b10;  // bit 1 is high
            4'b0001: pos <= 2'b11;  // bit 0 is high
            default: pos <= 2'b00;  // all bits low
        endcase
    end

endmodule

Prob100_fsm3comb.code:
module TopModule (
    input  in,
    input  [1:0] state,
    output [1:0] next_state,
    output out
);

    // Next state logic (combinational)
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // State A
                next_state <= in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // A=00, B=01
            end
            2'b01: begin // State B
                next_state <= in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // B=01, C=10
            end
            2'b10: begin // State C
                next_state <= in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // C=10, D=11
            end
            2'b11: begin // State D
                next_state <= in ? 2'b10 : 2'b01; // D=11, B=01
            end
            default: next_state <= 2'b00;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic (combinational, Moore machine)
    assign out = (state == 2'b11) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

endmodule
